newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African holiday road death toll over 1,000.
newsitem.headline: S.African holiday road death toll over 1,000.

text.p: At least 1,016 people have died on South Africa's roads during the Christmas holiday break, officials said on Thursday.
Traffic officials said in a statement they expected more deaths when the last holiday-makers returned home this weekend to the industrial heartland after summer vacations at coastal resorts.
They said most fatalities were caused by head-on collisions and pedestrians being run over due to speeding and drunk- driving.
No comparative figures for the same period of 1995 were given, but the latest death toll was believed to be sharply higher.
